# Gradle Wrapper

The Gradle wrapper files should be generated when you first open the project in Android Studio.

If you encounter issues, you can generate the wrapper manually by running:

```bash
gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.2
```

Or download the gradle-wrapper.jar from:
https://github.com/gradle/gradle/tree/master/gradle/wrapper

The wrapper ensures that the correct version of Gradle is used for the project.
